brands.name: Runyon Surfboards
brands.short_description: Handcrafted custom surfboards from Clint Runyon in Eastern North Carolina — fishes, grovelers, mid-lengths, and longboards shaped for Wrightsville Beach and beyond.

models.name: Mini Hammer
models.description: The Mini Hammer is my refined take on the infamous mini Simmons. It delivers pure fun in the most compact package around. Designed for speed, glide, and effortless wave catching, this board turns everyday surf into something special. Shaped for East Coast conditions and available across the USA. Design and Performance The Mini Hammer features a rounded squared nose and applies the classic planing hull concept with modern refinements. Key design elements include: Heavily rolled entry Refined step rails Thinned out tail Softened wide diamond tail The wide point sits just ahead of center with low entry and exit rocker. This creates excellent stability, fast paddling, and smooth acceleration in small to medium surf. Ride this board short and experience a fast, skatey feel as you fly across sections. Bottom Contours Rolled entry flowing into flat through the midsection, transitioning into spiral vee through the tail. This combination provides easy speed with reliable rail to rail control. Fin Configurations Primarily built as a Quad for maximum speed and drive. Optional setups include: Twin Keel Twinzer SIXER Ideal Wave Conditions Perfect for: Small and weak surf 1 to 3 ft beach breaks Everyday East Coast conditions Works up to head high This board is a must have for surfers looking for speed and flow in everyday waves. Who It’s For Perfect for surfers looking for the shortest “fun-first” board that excels in small junky to medium surf. If you love speed, and flying across sections with modern refinements, this board is for you! This board is a must have on the east coast of the US! Sizing Available from 4’0” up to 6’6” Mega Simmons. Pricing Boards start at $1100 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: Pod Racer
models.description: The Pod Racer is my East Coast performance fish built for everyday beach break conditions. Fast, responsive, and extremely user friendly, this board is a true daily driver from knee high to head high surf. Designed to blend classic fish speed with modern small wave performance. Design and Performance The Pod Racer combines elements from my traditional Fish and the Fully Auto small wave performance board. Key design features include: Fuller outline with thinner foil Volume hidden under the chest for easy paddling Mini swallow tail for release and speed Wide point slightly forward of center Low entry rocker with moderate exit rocker Medium rails There is no beak in this design. The board carries its volume cleanly through the center for smooth acceleration and easy wave catching. Ride it at or slightly below your height for maximum responsiveness, or size up for extra glide. Bottom Contours Deep single concave transitioning into double through the fins and tail. This contour provides speed off the bottom and control through tighter turns. Fin Configurations Primarily built as: Twin plus Trailer Also available as: Thruster Quad Five fin 7UP setup Ideal Wave Conditions Perfect for: Knee high to head high beach breaks East Coast sandbars Small to punchy surf A versatile performance fish that stays fast in everyday conditions. Who It’s For Surfers looking for a versatile, fast, small wave performance board that excels in everyday beach break conditions. Sizing Available from 5’0” to 6’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1200 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: Pescado
models.description: The Pescado is my take on the classic fish surfboard. Timeless glide with modern refinements built for speed and flow in a wide range of conditions. Fast, smooth, and built to trim, this board keeps the traditional fish feel while adding performance where it matters. Design and Performance The Pescado keeps the classic full fish outline but features slightly thinned rails for added bite and control. Key features include: Straight railed wide swallow tail Beaked nose with volume under the chest Thinned out swallow tail for hold Medium to low rails The wide point sits well forward of center with low entry and exit rocker. Ride this board slightly below your height and enjoy effortless glide and trim speed. Bottom Contours Rolled entry into slight concave, blending into spiral vee through the fins and tail. This creates smooth rail transitions while maintaining classic fish drive and speed. Fin Configurations Available as: Twin Keel Quad Twinzer SIXER Ideal Wave Conditions Perfect for: Waist high runners Small to medium beach breaks Clean or playful surf Can be pushed into overhead conditions This board delivers speed and flow across a wide range of East Coast conditions. Who It’s For Surfers who love classic and timeless fish speed and feel. You want to go fast and lock into trim. Sizing Available from 4’6” to 6’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1300 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: Fully Auto
models.description: Fully Auto is built for automatic speed in small waves. This is my personal go-to small wave board and a proven East Coast daily driver. Designed to generate effortless speed in weak surf, this board blends Fish DNA with modern small wave performance design. Design and Performance The Fully Auto features a full, curvy outline with a wide tail block flowing into a rounded pin tail. Key features include: Wide point at center for balance Medium to full rails Low entry rocker Moderate tail rocker Ride this board a couple inches below your height for maximum speed and responsiveness. It delivers immediate acceleration while staying stable and controlled when pushing through sections. Bottom Contours Deep single concave through the middle blending into double, transitioning into spiral vee and flat off the tail. Optional quad channels or wide center channel available for added drive. Fin Configurations Available as: Five fin Thruster Quad 7UP setup This board is commonly ridden as a quad for maximum small wave speed. Ideal Wave Conditions Perfect for: Small weak surf Summer beach breaks 1 to 3 ft waves Works up to head high A true small wave weapon built for East Coast conditions. Who It’s For Surfers who want maximum speed in weak or small surf and a board that stays fast and snappy all summer long. Sizing Available from 4’6” up to 7’0”. Pricing Boards start at $1200 Interested? Call us or send email and let’s design your board.

models.name: Sledgehammer
models.description: The Sledgehammer is the performance evolution of the Mini Hammer, bringing more responsiveness, tighter turns, and modern small wave performance into a fast and fun design. Built as a must have everyday performance board for the East Coast, the Sledgehammer keeps the glide and ease of use from the Simmons inspired Mini Hammer while adding refined performance elements that allow surfers to push harder and surf more aggressively. With its narrowed outline, hard angled vector tail, and deep channel design, the Sledgehammer delivers speed, drive, and control in a wide range of everyday surf conditions. Design and Performance The Sledgehammer refines the Mini Hammer platform into a more aggressive performance oriented board. Key design features include: Reduced nose area for improved responsiveness Narrower outline for faster rail to rail surfing Hard angled vector tail with short swallow for drive and release Deep channels that generate speed and control Softer step rails for sensitivity and maneuverability The result is a board that maintains the fun speed of the Mini Hammer while allowing surfers to push harder and attack the lip. Bottom Contours The bottom contours focus on speed, control, and drive. Light rolled entry through the nose Blending into subtle single concave through the center Deep channels through the tail This combination helps maintain speed while improving control at higher surfing speeds. Fin Configurations The Sledgehammer can be built in several fin setups depending on the rider's preference. Five fin setup Thruster configuration Quad configuration 7UP fin setup Ideal Wave Conditions The Sledgehammer performs well in a wide range of everyday surf. Small weak beach break waves Junky everyday surf Clean sandbar conditions Works from tiny runners up to head high waves Who It’s For The Sledgehammer is ideal for surfers who enjoy the speed and glide of the Mini Hammer but want more performance and responsiveness. Perfect for riders who want a fast small wave board that can still push hard turns and handle better waves when conditions improve. Sizing Available from 4’0” up to 7’0” (Mega Size). Pricing Boards start at $1200. For more information Call or Email

models.name: The Requirement
models.description: If you could only own one board, this might be it. The Requirement is a versatile mid length surfboard designed to cover a huge range of conditions. Built as a true one board quiver, it delivers glide, stability, and performance when the waves start to push. Design and Performance The Requirement features a full but slightly pulled in nose for added stability and versatility across many wave types. Key features include: Wide point forward of center Medium rails with customizable options Medium entry rocker with added exit rocker Balanced outline for glide and control Ride this board about 12 inches above your height or in the 7 to 8 foot range for optimal mid length performance. This design keeps you catching waves and staying in the water longer. Bottom Contours Rolled entry into slight single concave, transitioning into spiral vee through the tail. Optional four channel setup available for additional drive and control. Fin Configurations The Requirement can be built in nearly any configuration: Single 2 + 1 4 + 1 Thruster Quad Five fin 7UP setup Ideal Wave Conditions Built to handle a wide range of surf conditions. Waist high waves Punchy beach breaks Point breaks Larger surf when the waves are pumping This is a mid length designed to keep you catching waves and enjoying longer sessions. Who It’s For The Requirement is built for surfers who want one board that can truly do it all. From progressing surfers looking for stability and glide to experienced riders wanting a versatile performance mid length, this board delivers a huge usable wave range and dependable performance. Sizing Available from 6’10” up to 8’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1500. For more information Call or Email

models.name: Malibu
models.description: The Malibu is one of the most classic and stable surfboard designs ever created. Built for easy paddling, smooth trimming, and consistent wave catching, this board is a perfect blend of stability and progression. My version of the Malibu keeps the timeless design while allowing surfers to develop turning and trimming skills as their surfing improves. Design and Performance The Malibu features a full nose and forgiving outline designed to maximize wave count and stability. Key design elements include: Full nose for easy paddling and wave entry Wide point forward of center for balance Full rails for stability Medium entry rocker with slightly increased exit rocker This combination allows the board to glide effortlessly while still providing enough responsiveness for trimming and turning. Bottom Contours Rolled entry transitioning into slight single concave or flat through the middle, finishing with light vee in the back half of the board. This design keeps the ride smooth and predictable across a wide range of conditions. Fin Configurations The Malibu can be built in multiple setups: Single 2 + 1 Thruster Quad Five fin 7UP configuration Ideal Wave Conditions The Malibu works in a wide range of conditions. Small rolling waves Beach breaks Point breaks Waist high up to head high surf A dependable board designed to keep you catching waves and staying in the water longer. Who It’s For The Malibu works for surfers of all skill levels. Beginners will appreciate the easy paddling and stability, while intermediate surfers will enjoy the ability to trim, turn, and progress their surfing as their skills improve. Sizing Available from 6’8” up to 8’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1500. For more information Call or Email

models.name: King Fish
models.description: The King Fish is my stretched out long fish built for glide, flow, and effortless speed. Combining the speed of a classic fish with the glide of a mid length or glider inspired design, this board delivers smooth performance across a wide range of waves. Fast, flowing, and incredibly fun, the King Fish is designed to keep you moving across the water with ease. Design and Performance The King Fish features a refined long fish outline designed for speed and control. Key design elements include: Stretched fish outline with glider inspired glide Wide point slightly forward of center Medium to low rails for control Low to medium entry rocker with slightly increased exit rocker This combination creates a board that paddles easily, catches waves early, and carries speed through long sections. Bottom Contours Flat entry transitioning into center concave running through the fins and out the tail. This design generates effortless speed and smooth down-the-line glide. Fin Configurations Primarily built as: Twin Quad Twinzer Long based keel fins can be used for added drive, or glassed on wooden keels can be added for a classic feel. Ideal Wave Conditions Best suited for clean surf and longer period waves. Waist high runners Clean beach breaks Point waves Works up to head high and beyond This board is designed for flowing lines and smooth trim surfing. Who It’s For The King Fish is perfect for surfers who want the glide of a longer board with the speed and feel of a fish. From intermediate surfers looking for easy wave catching to experienced riders wanting smooth flowing lines, this board offers effortless speed and trim across a wide range of conditions. Sizing Available from 7’0” up to 10’0”. Pricing Boards start at $1600 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: DangDang
models.description: The DangDang is a four channel twin pin that has quickly become one of my most popular models. Originally developed in 2020, this board delivers smooth speed, control, and a flowing ride across a wide range of surf conditions. Fast, fluid, and incredibly fun, the DangDang feels like a magic carpet under your feet. Design and Performance The DangDang blends twin fin speed with a refined mid length outline. Key design features include: Fuller nose outline for easy paddling Rounded pin tail for control and hold Wide point forward of center for balance Medium to low entry rocker with moderate exit rocker Medium to low rails with refined foil The result is a board that carries speed effortlessly while remaining responsive through turns. Ride the DangDang slightly shorter than a traditional mid length for optimal performance. Bottom Contours Light rolled entry transitioning into light single concave through the center, blending into panel vee with four deep channels out the tail. The channels provide additional drive and hold while maintaining the speed and glide of a twin fin design. Fin Configurations Primarily built as: Twin Twinzer These setups maximize speed while maintaining smooth rail transitions and flow. Ideal Wave Conditions The DangDang works across a wide range of surf. Waist high runners Everyday beach breaks Clean or punchy waves Works up to larger surf when pushed A fast, flowing board designed for surfers who want speed and control with a unique twin fin feel. Who It’s For The DangDang is designed for intermediate and advanced surfers who enjoy the speed and flow of twin fin surfing with added control. If you want a fast board that blends mid length glide with twin fin performance and channel drive, the DangDang is an incredible choice. Sizing Typically built from 6’4” up to 7’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1500 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: Hajimari
models.description: Hajimari, Japanese for “the beginning,” is my most user friendly performance mid length surfboard. Designed to do it all, this board delivers glide, control, and versatility across an incredibly wide range of surf conditions. The Hajimari has evolved from my very first board shaped in the 90s and has been refined through years of development into the model it is today. Design and Performance The Hajimari combines accessibility with performance in a balanced mid length design. Key design features include: Fuller front outline for easy paddling Pulled in squash tail for responsiveness Wide point forward of center for stability Medium entry rocker with moderate exit rocker Rolled deck with refined medium rails The result is a board that is stable, forgiving, and capable of handling a huge range of waves. Bottom Contours The Hajimari features a unique bottom design. Chined bottom entry Slight single concave up front Deeper concave through the middle Blending into spiral vee through the tail This contour combination provides speed, control, and smooth rail transitions. Fin Configurations Primarily built as a Five Fin setup . Also available as: 2 + 1 Thruster Quad 7UP configuration Ideal Wave Conditions The Hajimari is built to handle a wide range of conditions. Thigh high runners Everyday beach breaks Clean point waves Works up to head high surf A versatile mid length that works as a true daily driver. Who It’s For The Hajimari is designed for a wide range of surfers, from beginners to advanced riders. If you want a versatile mid length that paddles easily, catches waves early, and still allows performance when the surf improves, the Hajimari is an excellent daily driver. Sizing Available from 6’10” up to 8’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1500 . For more information Call or Email

models.name: The GG (Glider Gun)
models.description: The GG (Glider Gun) is a high performance big board designed to combine paddle power, wave catching ability, and real turning performance. This is not just a trimming cruiser. The GG was built for surfers who want the advantage of a larger board while still being able to set a rail and push hard through turns. After riding the first versions of the GG it quickly became clear that this board has an incredibly wide wave range. It paddles easily in smaller surf but also handles waves with real power and size. Design and Performance The GG blends glide, paddle power, and performance into a large board that remains surprisingly nimble. Key design features include: Added rocker throughout the board for control Chined bottom rails for speed and smooth rail transitions Balanced outline that can be tuned for fuller volume or refined performance Large size range designed for maximum paddle power and wave catching The result is a powerful big board that still feels responsive and maneuverable in a wide range of surf. Bottom Contours The bottom design focuses on speed, drive, and smooth rail engagement. Chined bottom rail design Aggressive inset single concave Blending into spiral vee through the tail This contour combination creates lift, speed, and control when transitioning between rails. Fin Configurations The GG can be configured in multiple setups depending on rider preference. Five fin setup for thruster or quad options 2 + 1 setup 7UP configuration Ideal Wave Conditions The GG is designed to handle a massive wave range. Small waist high runners Everyday beach breaks Clean point waves Powerful overhead surf This board paddles easily into waves and still performs when the surf gets serious. Who It’s For The GG is designed for surfers who want the paddle power and wave count of a larger board without sacrificing performance. Ideal for riders looking for glide, easier paddling, and the ability to push hard turns on a bigger board. Sizing Available from 7’6” up to 10’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1600. For more information Call or Email

models.name: The Glider
models.description: The Glider lives up to its name. These boards are built for effortless flow, long trimming lines, and unmatched glide across the water. The feeling of riding a Glider is unlike anything else in the lineup, offering a smooth, flowing ride that carries speed naturally down the line. With its long parallel rail line and refined pin tail, the Glider creates incredible forward momentum while still remaining surprisingly maneuverable for a board of its size. Design and Performance The Glider is designed to maximize trim speed, glide, and paddle power while maintaining control and fluid movement through the water. Key design features include: Long parallel outline for maximum glide Smooth pin tail for control and hold Medium entry rocker for easy paddling More pronounced tail rocker for maneuverability Rail profile transitioning from rolled entry to refined performance rails Despite its size, the Glider remains smooth, responsive, and incredibly fun to surf. Bottom Contours The bottom design promotes smooth water flow and effortless speed. Rolled entry through the nose Inset channel concave through the midsection Blending into vee through the tail This contour combination helps the board maintain speed while allowing smooth rail transitions. Fin Configurations The Glider can be configured depending on the style of ride you want. Single fin 2 + 1 setup 4 + 1 setup Ideal Wave Conditions The Glider performs best in clean, longer period waves where trim and glide can shine. Small clean peelers Point breaks Open beach break walls Works from small surf up to well overhead waves Who It’s For The Glider is ideal for intermediate to advanced surfers who want maximum glide, paddle power, and wave count. Perfect for riders looking for a unique board that offers smooth flow, long rail lines, and a completely different surfing experience. Sizing Available from 9’6” up to 14’0”. Pricing Boards start at $2400. For more information Call or Email

models.name: The Proverb
models.description: The Proverb is my updated noserider longboard and currently my best performing log. This board blends classic longboard glide with refined performance, creating a stable platform designed for smooth trim and long noserides. Built for surfers who love traditional longboard style, the Proverb combines timeless design elements with subtle performance refinements to keep the board lively and responsive. Design & Performance The Proverb is designed to deliver stability, trim speed, and excellent noseriding capability. Key design features include: Wide point slightly aft of center for stability and trim Lower entry rocker for smooth paddling and glide Increased tail rocker for controlled noseriding Classic longboard outline with balanced volume Full deck options with custom resin tint, pinlines, and fabric inlays The result is a board that locks into trim easily while still allowing smooth turns from the tail. Bottom Contours The bottom contours are designed to support long noserides while maintaining smooth rail transitions. Nose concave through the front section Rolled bottom through the middle Panel vee through the fins Slight flat off the tail This combination provides lift in the nose for noseriding while keeping the board flowing smoothly through turns. Fin Configuration The Proverb is designed as a classic longboard single fin. Single fin setup for traditional glide and trim control. Ideal Wave Conditions The Proverb performs best in clean, longer period waves where noseriding and trim shine. Small clean peelers Point breaks Clean beach break walls Works best from knee high up to head high surf Who It’s For The Proverb is designed for surfers who want a classic noseriding longboard with dependable performance. Perfect for intermediate to advanced surfers who enjoy traditional longboard style, smooth trimming, and walking the board with confidence. Sizing Available from 9’0” up to 10’6”. Pricing Boards start at $1900. For more information Call or Email

models.name: The Cutback
models.description: The Cutback is my version of a high performance longboard designed to be fast, nimble, and extremely maneuverable. Built to handle a wide range of surf conditions, this board delivers stability under your feet while still allowing tight turns and quick rail transitions. With its refined outline and performance rocker, the Cutback brings modern responsiveness to a classic longboard platform. Design and Performance The Cutback focuses on maneuverability and responsiveness while maintaining the glide expected from a longboard. Key design features include: Pulled-in longboard outline for performance Medium to high entry rocker for control in steeper waves Substantial tail rocker for tighter turning radius Hard chined bottom through most of the board 50/50 rails in the front transitioning into 60/40 rails through the tail The result is a longboard that feels stable when trimming but incredibly agile when pushed through turns. Bottom Contours The bottom design blends speed with control. Hard chined bottom through most of the board Single concave entry Rolling into spiral vee through the fins Small flat section off the tail This contour setup provides lift, drive, and smooth rail transitions when turning. Fin Configurations The Cutback can be configured in multiple ways depending on rider preference. Single fin 2 + 1 4 + 1 Five fin 7UP configuration Ideal Wave Conditions The Cutback performs across a wide range of surf conditions. Waist high runners Everyday beach breaks Clean point waves Works up to powerful head high surf Who It’s For The Cutback is designed for surfers who want a performance longboard that can turn quickly and stay responsive in the pocket. Ideal for riders looking for the glide of a longboard with the maneuverability and responsiveness of a more performance oriented shape. Sizing Available from 8’6” up to 10’0”. Pricing Boards start at $1600. For more information Call or Email
